Watch: Keep a close eye on the broader market reaction to the sovereign wealth fund's warning. Also, monitor any further developments around AI regulation or risk evaluation.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management in your leveraged and underperforming positions, and be highly selective with any new tech entries.
plays: Consider reducing exposure to SOXL and SPAL. Their leveraged nature and significant drawdowns (-57.41% and -30% respectively) are amplified by margin, making them high-risk.
